How long to rest if you don't get sore muscles?

Soreness comes from the tearing of muscle. The main form of muscle growth comes from the repairing of the muscle. If you aren't getting sore it's a sign you are only building lean muscle, thus you won't need to worry about rest days

Also helps if you really push your self for strength gains.

It depends on how you work out. If you just do a daily routine of x number of bodyweight exercise then you might only need to take one day off every few days. If you are weightlifting but are not lifting to failure point and really grinding up against the limits of what you can do, then 1 day off is ok. This seems most common, people will lift three days a week. If you are weightlifting to failure and just grinding your muscles out to the point of total destruction, you'll need more time.

The best way to know for sure is to keep a log of your workout sessions. I don't know how long you've been working out reguarly, but there's a period when you first start where you are progressing much faster than later.
